te: The new old-age pension formula (the CARE formula) studied
se: The meeting studied the CARE formula, which uses the average wage over the whole working life instead of the average of the last 60 months to calculate pensions. It has been studied with the International Labour Organization since 2019, and in 2025 it was proposed to go ahead with it together with a strategy for the fund's financial sustainability
it: Change to the old-age pension formula (the CARE formula)

te: Ministry of Public Health heard on a social security hospital
se: The meeting continued to consider the idea of setting up a social security hospital. The Department of Health felt that a hospital only for insured persons would need to be large to reduce crowding, and the National Health Security Office felt that more service units are still needed
it: The idea of setting up a social security hospital

te: Joint meeting on financial products for insured persons
se: The subcommittee held a joint meeting with the Subcommittee on Finance of the Senate Committee on Economy, Monetary Affairs and Finance to study whether state financial institutions could work with the Social Security Office to develop special financial products for insured persons, with representatives of the Fiscal Policy Office and other agencies giving information
it: Cooperation in developing financial products for insured persons

te: The idea of a social security hospital discussed
se: The meeting considered the idea of setting up a social security hospital, a demand workers raise every year on National Labour Day so that insured persons have a secure source of medical care, inviting the Social Security Office to give information
it: The idea of setting up a social security hospital

te: The idea of setting up a labour bank supported
se: The meeting supported the approach of setting up a labour bank (a social security bank) so that insured persons and small business operators can reach sources of loans and rely less on informal debt, as many insured persons now find it hard to borrow because of credit and collateral requirements. It considered possible forms, such as a financial institution under the Social Security Office or a cooperative
it: Approaches to setting up a labour bank (a social security bank)

te: Study results heard on the idea of an independent, semi-state social security fund
se: The meeting heard information from the Consulting Institute for Efficiency Development in the Public Sector on its study project on a new way of managing the Social Security Fund as an independent, semi-state fund, which surveyed the views of insured persons and prepared an organisation plan, as an option for changing its form
it: Results of the study on the idea of an independent, semi-state social security fund

te: Social Security Office heard on its form of organisation
se: The meeting considered social security and whether it needs to leave the civil service system. The Social Security Office stated that it had studied several options, such as a public organisation, a specialised independent body or staying in the current system, with the advantages and limits of each
it: Social security and whether it needs to leave the civil service system

te: Study begins on whether social security should leave the civil service system
se: The meeting began to study social security and whether it needs to leave the civil service system, as working under civil service rules may slow the adjustment of policy to insured persons' needs, and insured persons' confidence in the fund should be strengthened
it: Social security and whether it needs to leave the civil service system

te: Proposal to extend social security coverage to every occupation considered
se: The meeting considered a proposal to study extending universal social security coverage to every occupational group, including compensation for illness or injury at work, and to review the long-term benefits of personnel in organisations outside the social security system
it: Proposal to extend universal social security coverage

te: 4 options proposed for rules on electing Social Security Board members
se: The meeting considered 4 options for rules on electing employer and insured person representatives, to propose to the Social Security Office for use next time, such as an option in which provincial social security subcommittees screen local representatives, for transparency, economy and openness to participation
it: 4 options for rules on electing Social Security Board members

te: Lessons from the Social Security Board election reviewed
se: The meeting considered observations on the first election of the Social Security Board (24 December 2023). The Social Security Office explained that the election followed the Social Security Act and the Ministry of Labour regulation, and the meeting noted the problems found so that they can be improved next time
it: Observations on the first election of the Social Security Board (24 December 2023)

te: Proposals for advancing universal social security
se: The meeting continued to consider advancing universal social security, with proposals such as developing the law to extend coverage, linking long-term accumulation of entitlements, contribution rates in line with benefits, and restructuring the Social Security Office in line with its workload

te: Summary of the discussion with Social Security Office executives
se: The meeting noted the information and recommendations from its discussion with the Secretary-General, executives and the Social Security Board on 19 May 2025, on matters such as the status of the Social Security Fund and the Workmen's Compensation Fund, investment management and improving services
it: Approaches to strengthening the sustainability of the Social Security Fund

te: Discussion at the Social Security Office prepared, and the fund sustainability forum summarised
se: The meeting noted the schedule of a study visit to the Social Security Office on 19 May 2025 to discuss the stability of the fund with the Secretary-General, executives and the Social Security Board, and considered the summary of the forum on approaches to strengthening the sustainability of the Social Security Fund
it: Schedule of the study visit to the Social Security Office (19 May 2025)
Summary of the forum on approaches to strengthening the sustainability of the Social Security Fund
